entities.summary: Sarah Ladipo Manyika FRSL is a British-Nigerian writer. She is the author of In Dependence (2009) and Like A Mule Bringing Ice Cream To The Sun (2016). Her articles have appeared in publications including Granta, Transition, Guernica, and OZY, which she served as founding books editor. Manyika's work also features in the 2019 anthology New Daughters of Africa edited by Margaret Busby.
